blocks.title: Terms
blocks.lead: The terms for using teleionlabs.com and Tessera, in plain words. Updated November 2, 2026.

blocks.heading: Who runs it
paragraphs: Teleion Labs Incorporated runs teleionlabs.com and Tessera.

blocks.heading: Free through December 31, 2026
paragraphs: Tessera is free to use until 11:59 PM Eastern on December 31, 2026, within the limits on the [Free page](/free/) and fair use.
There are no payments. Nothing on these sites asks for or takes money.

blocks.heading: Fair use
paragraphs: If someone's use crowds out others or harms the service, we may slow it down or stop it.

blocks.heading: Private information
paragraphs: Don't submit private information. We don't accept private information at this stage.

blocks.heading: No warranty
paragraphs: We offer these sites and Tessera as they are, with no warranty. They may change, slow down or stop, and a free session's work is deleted after 24 hours.
